items.text: Model::Draw shares one static scratch buffer across threads (concurrent draws race).

items.section: The draw contract: a model is more than a bag of pointers
items.text: ModelMesh::Draw guards Ensure3DSupported with a null-device check but then dereferences graphicsDevice_ unconditionally for a positive-count part, so a mesh built with a null device crashes instead of failing cleanly.

items.section: The draw contract: a model is more than a bag of pointers
items.text: Model::Draw on a zero-bone model with a mesh effect reads sharedDrawBoneMatrices_[0] without growing the vector (empty on a fresh thread, or a stale slot from an earlier model); operator[] is unchecked.

items.section: The draw contract: a model is more than a bag of pointers
items.text: CopyAbsoluteBoneTransformsTo assumes parent-before-child bone order and does not detect cycles or misordering in hand-built graphs; documented construction invariant.

items.section: Collections are read views, but not uniform ones
items.text: Model bone/mesh collections were said to accept an empty name where FNA rejects null-or-empty; at TARGET TryGetValue throws ArgumentNullException for an empty name.
Only EasyGL has renderer-local Model draw/hierarchy example programs; other GPU families render Model graphs only through the glTF L7 campaigns.

items.section: A two-target morph from the test suite
items.text: BlendMorphTargetsEXT indexes NormalDeltas[t] for every weighted target without checking the outer vector length (TangentDeltas is guarded) and indexes non-empty inner delta vectors by vertex without a length check; hand-built MorphTargetDataEXT with short arrays is undefined behaviour.

items.section: A two-target morph from the test suite
items.text: Morph targets on PBR strides kept rest-pose normals (normal deltas applied only for strides 32/52/56).

items.section: Four model asset routes, not two
items.text: The .cnj and .cnb Model routes carry no imported cameras; only direct glTF fills Model::CamerasEXT.
glTF import errors thrown as std::runtime_error escape a catch of ContentLoadException.
items.evidence: modules/content/include/Microsoft/Xna/Framework/Content/ContentManager.hpp (Load<T> wraps any std::exception from a loose reader in ContentLoadException, commit cd6587084); core functions still throw std::runtime_error to direct callers

items.text: The runtime glTF path computes a UV-set mismatch and discards it.
glTF input was not validated against extensionsRequired or structural constraints.
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md lists stb_vorbis but not the vendored cgltf header or the stb_image/stb_image_write headers compiled into cna_content.
asset.version is checked only when present and asset.minVersion is never inspected.
The doc comment above ReadGltfModel still says only the first mesh group is imported; the code imports every group (stale comment).
Runtime glTF import has no unit-scale control (fixed 1.0); only cna_tool_gltf_to_cnj and cna_tool_gltf_to_cnb scale; cna-content has no option.
Runtime glTF was said to import only the first mesh group; every group is imported at TARGET.
Factor-only metallic-roughness materials were said to lose their PBR state (D7); fixed at TARGET.
EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing imports one placement per node and drops per-instance transforms (reported).
The registry note for KHR_materials_specular lists seven renderer families sampling both maps while the test inventory lists eight (WebGPU); stale prose.

items.section: Indices: source width is not destination width
items.text: Index bytes were cast from vector<uint8_t>::data() to uint16_t*/uint32_t* before IndexBuffer::SetData (misaligned typed access).
Mirrored (negative-determinant) placements are not winding-corrected and can disappear under default culling; reported per placement (mirrored-winding-unapplied).

items.section: Hard limits carried by the bytes
items.text: The vertex ABI carries at most two distinct UV sets, four joint influences and one colour set; the rest is dropped and reported.

items.section: Why ordinary C++ structs were unsafe
items.text: An unknown stride used to yield an empty vertex buffer; at TARGET it throws ContentLoadException (GLTF-157).

AnimationPlayer sizes its vectors from static_cast<size_t>(BoneCount) before RecomputeTransforms validates, so negative BoneCount in hand-built SkinningData produces an allocation failure instead of ArgumentException.
A skinned model cannot carry rigid scene-node clips; rigid tracks not carried by a skin are dropped with the rigid-animation-dropped-on-skinned-model diagnostic.
Morph weight tracks come from the first node in file order that instances the mesh; every placement of a multi-placed mesh plays that track.
Cubic bone channels are baked onto union key times and played back linearly between them.
glTF skins with more than 72 joints are refused at import (palette limit).
The .cnj Model reader silently skips a mesh entry whose vertexStride is zero or negative instead of refusing the descriptor.
.cnj vertex/index sidecar sizes that are not whole multiples of the stride or index size are truncated by integer division rather than rejected.
The .cnj bones parser accepts a forward parent (parent >= child) and turns a transform of the wrong length into identity, loading an inconsistent graph instead of failing.
The skeleton sidecar's optional root-prefix block is detected by remaining size, so a partially written block is ignored; compatibility design choice.
An unknown positive vertexStride in a .cnj no longer produces an unfilled vertex buffer; refused with ContentLoadException.
No native point/spot lights: glTF punctual lights are approximated as up to three directional lights (GLTF ROBUST row 6).
METAL samples neither KHR_materials_specular texture map (factor-only).
Whole-corpus L7 campaigns for VULKAN, SOFTWARE and DIRECTX11 are recorded reports (2026-08-18, CNA b6c180fd), not CI-run; only the OPENGLES3 L7 rung runs in CI through an external pinned viewer.
The bounded Khronos retake matrix qualifies three renderers; a fourth (GLTF ROBUST row 12) is pending.
